scope: PaySim schema and causal customer-recipient sequence feasibility only; no model training or performance results

entity.definition: nameDest values beginning with C (customer recipients only)

time_and_target.target_field: isFraud (supervised target; never a feature/history field)

split_strategy: whole-step chronological split: train 1-281, validation 282-355, test 356-743

sequence_contract.history_rule: history(entity,t) contains eligible nameDest=C transactions only when history.step < target.step
sequence_contract.same_step_policy: all events at one step are simultaneous; no event in that step is prior history for another
sequence_contract.partition_history_policy: causal cross-partition context: each target can use earlier events from preceding partitions and its own partition, but only at strictly smaller steps; training targets therefore use training history only
sequence_contract.sequence_unit: distinct prior hourly step buckets; all events in a bucket are simultaneous and retained together
sequence_contract.truncation: retain the most recent maximum_sequence_length buckets; discard oldest buckets; never split a bucket
sequence_contract.ordering: ascending step order across buckets; events inside a bucket are an unordered set with canonical type/amount serialization only
sequence_contract.empty_history: emit target example with an empty history tuple
sequence_contract.short_history: retain all available prior step buckets
sequence_contract.entity_key: nameDest is retained only as example metadata and is not a model feature
sequence_contract.target_label: isFraud is stored separately from input features
excluded_features: nameOrig (not the selected entity; excluded from features)
nameDest (entity key only; not a model feature)

cap_training_history_distribution.cap_selection: nearest-rank 95th percentile of prior distinct step buckets per training target; training partition only

covered_invariants: history steps are strictly smaller than target steps
same-step events are not prior history
changing labels does not change history features
labels, rule flags, balances, and entity IDs are absent from history-event features
training targets do not consume validation/test events
merchant recipients are excluded and source entity IDs are preserved
step ordering, bucket truncation, and repeated construction are deterministic
streaming audit carries same-step recipient groups across CSV chunk boundaries
